entityName: University of Ljubljana, Biotechnical faculty - UL BF
entityDescription: The Faculty’s mission is to offer higher professional education, undergraduate and postgraduate university study programmes, as well as research and professional and advisory services in the areas of living nature (biology, microbiology), agriculture, forestry and fishery (forestry, animal science, agronomy) and in closely related production technologies (wood science, food science, biotechnology).All the educational and research disciplines provided at the Biotechnical Faculty incorporate the issues of management of natural resources (soil, space, flora and fauna, water). The Biotechnical Faculty, with its research into environmental resources and its sustainable management orientation, is an institution needed by every nation in its efforts to define and preserve its identity. Research and education in the area of life and nature obliges the Biotechnical Faculty to provide the professional and scientific foundations and an appropriate atmosphere in society that will enable the creation and development of a sustainable symbiotic existence between man and nature.Environmental renovation and protection, preservation of the natural and cultural heritage, ecological and sustainable use of natural resources like wood, production and processing of high quality food and the use of modern biotechnology, are global challenges demanding a constant and strenuous search for the new and better and for furthering expertise that will be widely accessible and utilized in everyday life.Scientific research at the Biotechnical Faculty comprises basic, applied and developmental work. It enables research findings and accomplishments to be widely accessible in life. Professional and advisory services, as part of the research activities, keep the staff of the Faculty informed about emerging needs and issues of practice, facilitates their participation in resolving problems and thus becoming familiar with new ideas that can be successfully applied in teaching and research. A circle is created: basic research – applied research – education – professional work and development. Such an approach requires close linkage with production in order to meet the practical needs of individual professions and those responsible for social development. With a variety of educational and research programmes, the Biotechnical Faculty encourages interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary approaches to education and integral research into developmental issues that are becoming more and more complex and influenced by the interests of various professions. In addition, it tries to promote and advance the highest quality, internationally recognized scientific and professional cooperation, openness, and a reputation for excellence. The international competitiveness of the Faculty guarantees the quality of its educational, research and developmental activities.

Company description: Innovation experience HUB (innexHUB), Digital Innovation Hub of East Lombardy, was established in July 2017 as a non-profit association by the Industrial Associations of Brescia, Cremona and Mantova and two craftmanship associations located in Brescia. The aim was to create a subject focused on spreading the digital culture among SMEs, making them aware of: what being digital means, what KETs are, how the digital is rapidly transforming business models and the current and future opportunities / threats linked to digital technologies.
innexHUB has two additional purposes: to help enterprises understand their digital maturity level and identify the subsequent actions to digitally evolve as well as to guide enterprises in their digital transformation paths, ensuring they can rely on trustworthy suppliers.
During 2017 and 2018 innexHUB strengthened its governance by engaging with 6 new shareholders (associations and confederations) representing 3 additional sectors: Agriculture, Construction and Commerce, Tourism and Hospitality Services. As of now innexHUB action field encompasses and addresses 4 sectors (Industry; Agriculture; Construction; Commerce, Tourism and Hospitality Services) as well as 1 horizontal cluster (Craftmanship) made of micro and small enterprises across different sectors.
It is worthy to mention that 2 Universities figure among innexHUB shareholders and their technical and scientific contribution is essential for the hubs’ governance and orientation (e.g., representatives from both Universities have a seat in the hub’s Technical and Scientific Committee).
Altogether innexHUB partners (shareholders) represent more than 50.000 SMEs located in the provinces of Brescia, Cremona and Mantova, equalling a third of the total population of active enterprises in the three provinces listed above.
In 2018 innexHUB has become fully operational by developing a catalogue of services that includes:
• Awareness creation: design and organization of seminars and workshops centred around the increasing role and opportunities of KETs and digitalization as well as the provision and dissemination of information / materials (e.g. videos and reports on best practices / success cases) by means of the hub’s website, e-learning platform and social channels;
• Digital Maturity assessment: development and administration of digital maturity / readiness assessments, both in self-assisted (freely accessible web-based application) and assisted modes (on premises interviews), to evaluate an enterprise current state of digital readiness (i.e., processes, products, tools, skills) and identify possible evolutionary trajectories;
• Ecosystem building, scouting, brokerage, networking: development of a catalogue of certified suppliers providing technical consulting in the design and implementation of digitalization projects as well as continuous training and education opportunities around digital topics to boost workforce upskilling;
• Access to funding: dissemination of digital innovation funding opportunities and support to SMEs in accessing to public and private funding instruments;
• Mentoring: support prior and during the implementation of digital transformation projects;
• Education and skills development: co-creation, in partnership with external organizations, of training and education courses providing intelligence on SMEs’ needs and how to better address them.

Company description: Confindustria Brescia was founded on the 14th of April 1897. It is the oldest Italian entrepreneurial organization, having been active for over 110 years. As part of the Confindustria system, the Association represents the industrial and services sectors in the province of Brescia in all the political, institutional, administrative and trade union bodies, both local and national, in order to safeguard their interests.
This Representation is coordinated with other trade associations operating in the province of Brescia to protect the general interests of industry and the competitiveness of the economy of Brescia.
Confindustria Brescia now brings together more than 1,300 large, small and medium-sized enterprises operating in different sectors and employing a labour force of over 67,000 people.

Mission and objectives
The main mission of the Confindustria Brescia is to support entrepreneurial culture, to promote the development of the area. Members of the Confindustria Brescia can be industrial firms and consortiums producing goods and offering services.
The main objectives of the Confindustria Brescia are:
· to encourage the spreading of entrepreneurial culture to develop the local economy through the promotion of innovation, the high quality of products and the improvement of production processes.
· to pursue sustainable growth of industrial activities by providing assistance, consulting, and training courses to companies.
· to develop competitiveness and the international aspect of industry in the area of Brescia.
· to promote a closer link between education and the production system.
· to assist the growth of employment and enhance the qualification of the workforce through training courses.
· to contribute to improving the local infrastructure facilities. 
· to strengthen interaction with local institutions and trade unions in order to develop the industrial framework of the province of Brescia along with the competitiveness of all firms.

Services
The Association, with all its various operational areas, offers services in crucial areas forentrepreneurial activities:
· Relations with trade unions; 
· Human resources management; 
· Labour standards and norms; 
· Safety and the environment; 
· Communication and media relations; 
· Training; 
· Credit and finance; 
· Internationalization;
· Tax and company law;
· Environmental issues; 
· Information about the association’s sectors and the protection of industrial and commercial property; 
· Innovation; 
· Energy and Climate
· Soustenaibility
· European affairs and legal monitoring
· PA regulation e and relations
· Legal

For further information, please contact Confindustria Brescia: www.confindustriabrescia.it

entityDescription:
We at the Atlas Aero GmbH are certain that personal transport will undergo substantial transformation within the next decade. Therefore, we have developed and conceptually optimized Origin – an airplane which combines the advantages of fixed-wing aircraft with vertical take-off and landing capabilities. Its efficiency in forward flight is unrivalled by any of the existing concepts.
 
Avoid congestion, travel at 300 kph while using just as much fuel as a smart car (<5l/100km or, up to 1500km. Use established infrastructure like streets and garages – all due to Origin’s foldable wings which allow for on-ground driveability at 30 kph and space-efficient parking. Due to the use of a serial hybrid drive, we can easily switch to fuel cells powered by hydrogen or synthetic fuels as soon as they become available. Purely electric versions of our aircraft for shorter distances are also viable.
 
Our first airplane version is targeting pilots and VIP transports as a competition to small helicopters – being faster, greener, higher in range and easier-to-fly. These advantages also make it a great choice for first responders. Due to the outstanding aerodynamic efficiency, Origin’s concept can easily be optimized to obtain travel speeds of >400kph if efficiency is not the primary priority.
 
The second generation is intended to fly autonomously and may therefore reach a mainstream market, competing with cars and enabling ride-sharing models – ideal for the infrastructure of the future.

entityDescription:
CGC has existed in one form or another for 30 years. Established in 1985 as a Materials Consultancy the company quickly developed an engineering/design competency concentrating on custom technical solutions for the aerospace, medical and industrial markets.
Demand for a “one-stop-shop” resulted in CGC developing and later expanding its manufacturing competency with the acquisition of a precision machine and fabrication shop in 2005. This acquisition is today organised under the Sheet Metal Precision Limited
Today, The CGC Group comprises two legal entities CGC Technology Limited & Sheet Metal Precision Limited. Both companies are ISO9001 accredited and CGC’s has a growing list of repeat business from blue-chip customers.
CGC’s technical competence and ability to innovate commercially attractive products was recognised by the UK Government in 2009 with the award of Queens Award for Enterprise: Innovation and our success in growing our business has been recognised this year by the UK Government with the 2016 Queens Award for Enterprise: Export.
In 2000 the company expanded into the manufacture of LEO satellite tracking antenna, delivering its first antenna in 2001. This system is still fully operational and in use by our client today.
In the intervening fifteen years CGC continued to innovate and develop its satellite ground station skills based adding competency in software writing, feed design, carbon reflector design (single and dual shaping), frequency selective subreflectors and low loss radome design.
Using the concept of product families and platform-based product development to increase variety, shorten lead-times, and reduce costs without compromising system performance CGC, today, is able to offer a product range, with generic ‘family’ features from 1.8M to 13M aperture to include auto-tracking systems as well as a range of deployable trailer mounted or fixed systems
CGC offers complete ground station solutions or will provide sections of the ground segment to global customer.

Albron is a foodservice company which is specialized in different areas. Namely: food concepts in business and industries, hospitality & leisure, health care and education. Among these areas we work with all different kind of nationalities, which gives us the opportunity to not only create different food concepts, but also a huge variety within our assortments. Due to this variety of experience we are able to create inspiring food concepts which align the vision of our clients. 
Our roots go back to 1900 in the harbour of Rotterdam. Together with the Rotterdam People’s Union and the Railway Temperance Association we started special halls where workers from the harbour could have their lunches warm and dry. The perspective was to provide the best food and drinks for the workers. This vision is still within our roots and gives us our identity. We continually strive to realise positive perspectives for all involved parties. Our clients, our guests, our staff and also the entire environment.

HORIBA MIRA (hereafter referred to as MIRA) is a global provider of pioneering engineering, research and test services to the automotive, defence, aerospace and rail sectors. We work in close collaboration with vehicle manufacturers and suppliers around the world, providing comprehensive support ranging from individual product tests to turnkey engineering design, development and build programmes. 
With over 70 years’ experience in developing some of the world’s most iconic vehicles, our engineers utilise the latest test facilities and simulation tools to make vehicles and journeys safer, cleaner, more efficient and rewarding. Our suite of 37 major test facilities, 100km of specialised proving ground and wealth of engineering experience, combined with our expanding international presence, means we are confident that we can achieve our vision – that by 2020 every journey in the world will be positively influenced by us.
Progress towards achieving our vision has been significantly accelerated through the creation of MIRA Technology Park, Europe’s largest transport technology R&D cluster. By applying our advanced engineering, test and validation capabilities to our customers’ challenging programmes, we are already shaping journeys of the future.

Panta Rhei gGmbH is a non-profit research and development organisation based in Cottbus, Germany, specialising in advanced materials and innovative manufacturing technologies.
The research centre focuses on the development, processing, joining and characterisation of metallic materials, particularly lightweight alloys such as aluminium, magnesium and titanium, as well as high-performance steels.
In close cooperation with Brandenburg University of Technology Cottbus-Senftenberg (BTU) and industrial partners, Panta Rhei conducts applied research, experimental investigations and technology transfer.
Core competencies include materials engineering, additive manufacturing, forming technologies, joining processes, surface engineering and advanced material characterisation. These capabilities support the development of innovative manufacturing solutions for demanding industrial applications, including the aerospace sector.

entityDescription: The initial nucleus of University Mediterranea of the city of Reggio Calabria dates back to 1968; when it was founded in order to promote the development and advancement of culture and science through research and education and to contribute to the development of civil, cultural, social and economic development of the country and Calabria. Today it includes 77 active Laboratories and six Departments: Agriculture, Heritage-Architecture-Urbanism, Architecture, Law, Economics and Human Sciences, Civil, Energy, Environmental and Material Engineering, and Information Engineering, Infrastructure and Sustainable Energy. The Mediterranean University has undertaken over the years the development of international cooperation through the creation of stable and productive links in teaching and research fields, with a keen interest in the Mediterranean basin. In Sept. 2019 UNIRC hosted the 4th international Space Forum: "Space Technology and Applications meet Mediterranean Needs”, in collaboration with the International Astronautical Federation (IAF) and the Italian Space Agency (ASI).
